name: fix-03
prompt:
Create ONE production game-icon SPRITE ATLAS, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows on a square canvas, ideally 2048x2048, genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha PNG. Input image is the user's approved style sheet, STYLE reference only. Match that soft tactile dimensional 3D collectible family: gentle warm upper-left diffuse studio light, rounded yet faithful forms, bright pastel/candy color, subtle ambient occlusion, restrained material detail. Each object's true material remains recognizable: paper, wood, glass, metal, woven cloth. No same-clay treatment on everything. No heavy dark outlines or flat vector art.

CRITICAL PACKAGING: There are EXACTLY NINE equal square virtual cells in a regular 3x3 grid. Draw ONE specified object/group centered within EACH virtual cell, at ONLY 48–52% of cell width/height, with at least 24% EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN ON EVERY SIDE. Nothing may touch a virtual cell edge or cross into a neighbor. All strings, handles, leaves and shadows stay inside their own cell. Think SMALL MINIATURE ICONS with LARGE EMPTY GUTTERS, NOT large illustrations filling the sheet. Icon centers are x=16.67%,50%,83.33%, y=16.67%,50%,83.33% of the image. Each icon must fit in a box 18% of the overall image size. Empty space between shapes is essential. No visible grid lines, no backgrounds, no color squares, no borders, no captions, numbers, words, ID labels, titles or decorative props. Empty padding is genuine alpha transparency, NOT a drawn checkerboard. Top-left through bottom-right order is mandatory; do not swap cells. Each tile will be cropped at exact one-third boundaries into a separate icon. Keep centered and similarly weighted, readable at 32–66px. All objects fully in frame, no cropping. Only allow inscription glyphs explicitly specified in subject. Do not invent sacred symbols, cultural ornament, claims or text. No extra humans/hands/landscape/pedestals. Subject list in strict row-major order:

INPUT ROLES: image 1 is the APPROVED SOFT 3D STYLE ONLY. Image 2 is an ORIGINAL ICON GEOMETRY GUIDE in the SAME row-major cells, with small identification labels underneath. Preserve its subject shapes/count/state, but transform flat shapes into the approved dimensional soft 3D material style. Do NOT copy guide labels, numbers, flat vector lines or cream background. Transparent output remains mandatory. The detailed corrections below take precedence over any ambiguous guide simplifications.
1. Cell row 1, column 1: One large translucent teal glass bead with a visible threading hole, two warm-gold curved decorative bands and soft glass highlights, threaded on a thin tan cord beside one small coral bead. Keep the hole and glass identity rather than turning the main bead into clay. CRITICAL: Match reference 1: one large transparent teal glass bead with two pale-gold curved bands and a small coral bead on a THIN FLEXIBLE TAN CORD that curves loosely underneath. Thread is soft textile, NOT a thick wooden skewer, metal rod or rigid horizontal stick. Keep clear glass.
2. Cell row 1, column 2: A pale golden-bamboo rectangular frame holding two hollow bamboo tubes of different lengths, one straw-yellow and one olive-green. Preserve the open tube mouths, small suspension ties, visible bamboo nodes and lower horizontal support rail. CRITICAL: Use reference 2 frame layout but the actual instrument MUST have TWO bamboo resonator tubes each with a visible FRONT-FACING LONGITUDINAL SLOT/window and a long narrow BACK TONGUE rising upward behind it. Each tube has a CLOSED LOWER NODE, no circular hole at bottom. Bamboo FEET REST ON and couple with the LOWER horizontal frame rail. NO free-hanging hollow wind-chime tubes, NO strings suspending the resonators. Preserve the framed bamboo percussion instrument, two tube sizes.
3. Cell row 1, column 3: A painted bamboo balancing dragonfly with four long wings: the upper pair muted teal and the lower pair ochre, two pale-gold round eyes and a slender coral body and tail. Its pointed beak balances on a thin brown upright twig above a small grey-green support. CRITICAL: Use reference 3 colors and head/wings, but balance geometry MUST be exact: a pointed long BEAK at the FRONT OF THE HEAD is the ONLY contact with the top of a thin branch/stand. The entire dragonfly BODY AND TAIL hang freely behind the head, NOT touching the stand anywhere. Pose as a delicate balancing bamboo dragonfly, head/beak forward and slightly downward, body and tail rising back to the right, four light slender wings spread. NO support under abdomen, tail or center of body.
4. Cell row 2, column 1: A painted dark-teal clay rooster facing right, with a raised sweeping tail, rust-red comb, ochre beak and legs, a small cream geometric chest mark and a terracotta display base; keep it a ceramic ornament, without invented lettering. CRITICAL: Match reference 4: dark teal ceramic rooster facing right, red comb, ochre beak/legs, plain terracotta rectangular base. Only ONE SMALL PLAIN IVORY DIAMOND on chest. No four-diamond arrangement, crescents, flowers, repeated patterns or additional decorative motifs on wings/tail.
5. Cell row 2, column 2: A silver-colored scalloped lock pendant hangs from a warm orange-brown cotton cord loop, with three small silver drop ornaments below. Preserve the broad cloud-like curved outline and minimal linear face marks; no keyhole, key or invented inscription. CRITICAL: Match reference 5: plain pale silver scalloped/cloud-outline lock pendant, complete soft ORANGE-BROWN cotton cord loop, three small silver drop ornaments below. The face has ONLY TWO SHORT STRAIGHT HORIZONTAL GROOVES. NO ornamental cloud engravings, curls, inscriptions, letters, key or keyhole. Preserve plain face and entire cord loop.
Cells 6 through 9: leave EMPTY and completely transparent.
